stem: A river ferry in Bangladesh can carry a load of at most 20,000 kilograms. For one crossing, each car on the ferry has a mass of 1,500 kilograms and each motorcycle has a mass of 250 kilograms, including their riders. If 11 cars are on the ferry, what is the greatest number of motorcycles that can also be on the ferry without exceeding the load limit?
solution: The 11 cars have a mass of \(11 \times 1{,}500 = 16{,}500\) kilograms.
Therefore \(m \le 14\). The greatest number of motorcycles is 14.
verify:
m = symbols('m')
s = solve_univariate_inequality(11*1500 + 250*m <= 20000, m, relational=False)
assert s == Interval(-oo, 14)
assert [Rational(a) for a in spr_answers] == [14]
